headline: WRONG
WITH THE
CROWD.

scenes.say: You'd rather be wrong with the crowd than right on your own. Science proved it.
Solomon Asch asked people to compare the length of lines. Everyone else in the room was an actor giving the wrong answer.
About {conform} of people went along with the wrong answer at least once.
Being wrong alone feels like being excluded. Being wrong together feels like company.
When you agree just because everyone agrees, that's your cue to check again.

takeaway: When you agree just because everyone agrees, that's your cue to check again.
